content: No off-the-shelf tool generates llms.txt+registry.json from .d.ts; standard pattern is a custom build script using ts-morph (query exported interfaces, props, JSDoc via getLeadingCommentRanges) or react-docgen-typescript (withCustomConfig parse). Script lives as a workspace tool/script, runs after react package types exist, emits llms.txt + registry.json into docs app public/ (and registry for phase 2). llms-txt-generator exists on npm but is generic, not .d.ts-driven.
